image_description: A single bagel resting on a white, wrinkled cloth surface. The bagel has a golden-brown crust but features significant anomalies: large, irregular patches of a smooth, opaque white substance (resembling melted plastic or thick icing) covering parts of the top surface, along with unnatural green leaf-like shapes embedded in or painted onto the white patches. There are also visible cracks or splits in the crust.
